lines.en: I think I found the light switch. Shut the door.
Am I hallucinating or are we surrounded by 2,000 Randy Jacksons?
Why does Ms. Briggs have all this stuff?
I guess if you're gonna be obsessed with an American Idol judge,
you might as well pick one that's firm but fair.
Yeah, dog. You did your thing.
Shh! You want Ms. Briggs to hear us?
Oh, please be quiet, Randy Jackson.
